parsed.lessons_learned: LP ranges need to be WIDER or more dynamic to handle pool price volatility. A 195-tick price swing knocked both positions out of range instantly. Either use wider ranges (sacrifice some fee efficiency) or be ready to reposition quickly when the pool moves. The tradeoff between tight concentration (more fees when in-range) vs wider range (more robust to price moves) needs to be balanced better. At 130K+ total liquidity, even tight positioning only generates modest fees for my capital size.
